title: Meet the Family
description: After being accepted into the Thieves Guild, Brynjolf instructs you to speak with Vex and Delvin Mallory to learn about the Guild and to Tonilia to receive your Guild Armor.

base_facts: Brynjolf is your sponsor in the Thieves Guild.
He told you to speak with Vex, Delvin Mallory, and Tonilia to get acquainted with the Guild.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Brynjolf's introduction task is complete; you have met Vex, Delvin, and received armor from Tonilia.
He expects you to check in with the guild members and undertake extra jobs to help get the Guild back on its feet.

base_facts: Vex is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who handles heist jobs.
She is not friendly and expects obedience from new recruits.

VEX_CONVERSATION: Vex believes the Guild's decline is due to simple bad luck and mocks Delvin's curse theory.
QUEST_COMPLETE: You have spoken with Vex and learned she attributes the Guild's decline to simple bad luck.
She is now available to offer extra jobs to help put coin in your pocket and restore the Guild.

base_facts: Delvin Mallory is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who handles numbers jobs.
He admits the Guild isn't what it used to be.

DELVIN_CONVERSATION: Delvin believes someone has cursed the Guild with misfortune and is determined to turn things around.
QUEST_COMPLETE: You have spoken with Delvin and learned he believes the Guild has been cursed with misfortune.
He is now available to offer extra jobs to help turn the Guild's fortunes around.

base_facts: Tonilia is Delvin Mallory's personal lookout in the Thieves Guild.
She provides new members with Thieves Guild Armor.

TONILIA_ARMOR: Tonilia gave you a full set of Thieves Guild Armor to get you equipped.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Tonilia has provided you with a full set of Thieves Guild Armor as your official equipment.
You are now properly equipped as a new member of the Thieves Guild.

beats.comment: Quest starts at stage 10. Brynjolf directs the player to meet the Guild members.
Player speaks with Vex and learns about the Guild's decline from her perspective.
Player speaks with Delvin and learns about the Guild's decline and his curse theory.
Player receives Thieves Guild Armor from Tonilia.
Quest finishes at stage 200 after speaking with Vex, Delvin, and receiving armor.
